what: Clicking a same-site link brings in a light-gray curtain from outside the right edge of the screen (width + height×tan30°), tilted skewX −30°, over 1s circ.inOut, then it straightens, covers the page and navigates. On the new page, a curtain widened on both sides by the skew slides out to the left after .2s over 1s, straightening as it goes. When going back, the direction is reversed.

options.mode: link (default — intercepts the link, covers, and navigates via location) · event (a transition tool like barba fires fx:cover · fx:reveal events, detail: { back, done })
options.links: Selector for links to intercept, default a[href]

use: — One at the very end of the document. With barba, data-fx-skew-sheet-page="mode: event" left as is, and fires fx:cover and fx:reveal on the transition out/in

from.where: shared.js .r-sheet — barba v1 ExpandTransition (next ±30° · back opposite · 1s Circ.easeInOut, walk after .2s)
